owner: Stable search-record heads, 256-node index pages, frontier pages grouped by node index, mutation generation acknowledgement and detached full checkpoint oracle.
laws: Pending searches recover with unchanged search progress and native snapshot identity.
Incremental pending-search capture and later page removal equal detached checkpoint bytes.
Acknowledgement of a prior generation retains subsequent search mutations.
Local node/frontier edits do not change unrelated page bytes.
Missing pages, misbound frontier indices and oversized counts are rejected.
Current callers use current versions; prior envelope/header/entity versions are rejected.
limitations: Changed-search serialization is bounded by the navigation bank limit; this is not touched-node-only encoding.
Capacity admission conservatively includes page wrappers and identity allowance; full recovery remains the relational oracle.
No hosted throughput or worker-capacity claim; the existing 40-step admission unit ran within the WASM suite.
